note: Read-only published evidence. Screenshots, plans, diffs and raw model requests/responses are byte-identical to the run manifests. run.json is a reduced, path-sanitized view; complete archives are attached where marked.

groups.title: Real upstream bugs · blind Nemotron runs
groups.summary: Each library is pinned just before a published maintainer fix. The maintainers' fix passes the frozen task; Nemotron gets only the buggy source, Super first and Ultra after a rejection.
